text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release v1.14.8 -> prod-usw2. Canary completed, staged rollout started. Rollout ID: rl_0a9f. Runbook: ops.redwood/runbooks/release-smoke.

maria: Heads up — sentinel synthetic for embed-route tripped at ~17:42 UTC, p95 spike on tailers. No 5xxs, just latency jitter.

aj: How big is the spike? user-visible?

maria: Observed: last 3 mins: p50=120ms, p95=940ms (baseline ~420ms), p99=1.8s. Traffic is small subset (route-embed, ~2% of traffic). No increase in errors.

kai: Likely scheduling/kvcache warmup for large prompts in this rollout. We can either increase sentinel tolerance temporarily or soft-pin route to previous variant. Soft-pin = route-level routing override for 30m -> low-risk mitigation.

olivia: Soft-pin buys time to confirm perf profile without full rollback. Any cost/quality tradeoffs?

kai: Minimal quality change for embeds (variant v1.9 -> v1.10 compatible). Cost delta negligible for this route.

aj: If we're soft-pinning, let's run a quick smoke against the embed route first. maria, can you run the curl payload we use for synthetic?

maria: Running now:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/embed-route/smoke 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -d '{"text": "lorem ipsum dolor sit amet"}' 
  -w '\nTIME_TOTAL:%{time_total}s\n' -o /dev/null
```

maria: Smoke result (before pin): TIME_TOTAL:0.98s

kai: Ok that's consistent with p95. I'll soft-pin the route for 30m and nudge sentinel thresholds for the window. Command I plan to run:
```bash
redwoodctl route pin --route embed-route --model redwood-embed-v1.9 --duration 30m --reason "postdeploy tail latency spike"
```

maria: Go ahead. I'll watch dashboards.

deploy-bot: Action completed: route pin applied -> embed-route pinned to redwood-embed-v1.9 for 30m by kai. Audit ID: audit_7c2b.

aj: I'll temporarily adjust sentinel (sentinel-config id: s_embed_route) to widen p95 alert threshold from 700ms -> 1.2s for 20m to avoid noisy pager. Will revert automatically.

sre-oncall: Noted. Escalate to PAG if 5xx > 0.5% or error-rate delta > 1% during the window.

maria: Re-ran smoke after pin (2m after): TIME_TOTAL:0.44s — looks back to baseline for that sample.

olivia: Nice, can we capture a short perf snapshot and add to release notes? Will help model ops.

kai: I'll attach perf snippet to the rollout and leave the pin for 30m. If stable, we'll let rollout continue; if not, escalate to rollback.

aj: I'll keep an eye on infra p95 and tracer spans for slow scheduling. If we see repeated >1.5s at p99, call rollback.

maria: I'll update the release thread and add a one-line note to the changelog: "temporarily routed embed-route to v1.9 for postdeploy perf verification (30m)"

deploy-bot: Reminder: pinned routes auto-unpin at 30m unless extended.

sre-oncall: Thanks all — monitoring.

maria: Closing this thread if no further anomalies in next 25m.
